name: Chesire Neko
source:
A complete flirt with a gaudy appearance. One to easily fall in love, Chesire has a tendency to fall for any girl at first sight. He loves fluffy things, and has a strange habit of putting the things he takes a liking to in his mouth. His motto is, "To love one girl forever... That is my justice!"

[Based on the [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/alice/#chara3]official website's character profile[/URL].]
